comments.author: ChuckNorris89
comments.story: Apple Vision Pro Headset to Launch in US Stores by Appointment
comments.text: > “Do you have an appointment?” No. “Oh, it’ll be about 45 minutes before someone can help you.” Ah, yes, the Ferrari customer experience. You need to be selected by the manufacturer to be allowed to buy their product. It makes the product feel rare and exclusive, and the customer feel "special", when it's a consumer product made by the same Chinese sweatshop workers that make your other e-waste. comments.story: Medical student surgically implants Bluetooth into own ear to cheat in final

comments.author: wodenokoto
comments.story: Apple leaker Kuo: Apple plans to replace the iPhone with AR in 10 years
comments.text: I think the eyePhone from Futurama clearly beats a handheld phone, but it might be a bit more than 10 years away. [VIDEO] Despite being a more than 10 year old iPhone parody it is pretty spot on even today. Very little has happened in smartphone land.
